status: exploratory expansion authorized after inspection of v5 search-boundary parameters
supersedes: v5 stop_after_v5 for this explicitly authorized experiment only

tuning.study_policy: Four fresh studies; one historical validation-selected recipe queued first and re-evaluated within each budget; no historical trials imported.
tuning.objective: mean per-label mean-fold Average Precision on all 109 training-supported labels
tuning.stop_rule: fixed eight-hour active budget per study; no extension after examining test results
tuning.incomplete_trial_policy: Interrupted trial marked FAIL; elapsed computation remains charged; completed trials and sampler retained.

robustness.selection_metric: mean macro AP across five repeated grouped-CV seeds
robustness.interpretation: not nested CV; descriptive development evidence, not an unbiased generalization estimate

threshold_selection.source: mean repeated grouped out-of-fold validation probabilities

test_access: evaluate all eight candidates only after recipes, all repeated-CV results, thresholds, and selected model are frozen
confirmatory_status: Historical test set was inspected in v2-v5; v3-v6 are exploratory. Repeating grouped CV does not restore an unseen test set. External data or a separately designed nested evaluation is future work.
next_action: Report gains and losses, freeze selected model; do not automatically create another tuning round or pseudo-label training.
